title: Adam
subtitle: Gen 5:3–5 | Lived 930 yrs
description: First man created by God. Father of Seth, Cain, and Abel. (AM 0–930)

title: Seth
subtitle: Gen 5:6–8 | Lived 912 yrs
description: Son of Adam born when Adam was 130 years old. (AM 130–1042)

title: Enos (Enosh)
subtitle: Gen 5:9–11 | Lived 905 yrs
description: Son of Seth. During his time, men began to call on the name of the Lord. (AM 235–1140)

title: Cainan (Kenan)
subtitle: Gen 5:12–14 | Lived 910 yrs
description: Son of Enos. (AM 325–1235)

title: Mahalaleel
subtitle: Gen 5:15–17 | Lived 895 yrs
description: Son of Cainan. (AM 395–1290)

title: Jared
subtitle: Gen 5:18–20 | Lived 962 yrs
description: Father of Enoch; second longest-lived patriarch. (AM 460–1422)

title: Enoch
subtitle: Gen 5:21–24 | Lived 365 yrs
description: Walked with God and was taken by God without experiencing death. (AM 622–987)

title: Methuselah
subtitle: Gen 5:25–27 | Lived 969 yrs
description: Oldest recorded human lifespan. Died in the year of the Great Flood. (AM 687–1656)

title: Lamech
subtitle: Gen 5:28–31 | Lived 777 yrs
description: Father of Noah; named his son expecting comfort from the cursed ground. (AM 874–1651)

title: Noah
subtitle: Gen 5–9 | Lived 950 yrs
description: Built the Ark by faith; survived the Great Flood in 2344 BC (AM 1656). (AM 1056–2006)

title: Shem
subtitle: Gen 11:10–11 | Lived 600 yrs
description: Son of Noah; ancestor of the Semitic peoples and Abraham. (AM 1558–2158)

title: Arphaxad
subtitle: Gen 11:12–13 | Lived 438 yrs
description: Born two years after the Flood. (AM 1658–2096)

title: Salah
subtitle: Gen 11:14–15 | Lived 433 yrs
description: Son of Arphaxad. (AM 1693–2126)

title: Eber
subtitle: Gen 11:16–17 | Lived 464 yrs
description: Eponymous ancestor of the Hebrew people. Outlived Abraham. (AM 1723–2187)

title: Peleg
subtitle: Gen 11:18–19 | Lived 239 yrs
description: In his days the earth was divided (Tower of Babel). (AM 1757–1996)

title: Reu
subtitle: Gen 11:20–21 | Lived 239 yrs
description: Son of Peleg. (AM 1787–2026)

title: Serug
subtitle: Gen 11:22–23 | Lived 230 yrs
description: Great-grandfather of Abraham. (AM 1819–2049)

title: Nahor
subtitle: Gen 11:24–25 | Lived 148 yrs
description: Grandfather of Abraham. (AM 1849–1997)

title: Terah
subtitle: Gen 11:26–32 | Lived 205 yrs
description: Father of Abraham, Nahor, and Haran; moved family from Ur to Haran. (AM 1878–2083)

title: Abraham
subtitle: Gen 12–25 | Lived 175 yrs
description: Father of the faithful; called from Ur by God; received Abrahamic Covenant. (AM 2008–2183)

title: Isaac
subtitle: Gen 21–35 | Lived 180 yrs
description: Son of promise born to Abraham and Sarah in their old age.

title: Jacob (Israel)
subtitle: Gen 25–49 | Lived 147 yrs
description: Renamed Israel by God; father of the 12 patriarchs of the tribes of Israel.

title: Judah
subtitle: Gen 29 / 49:10 | ~110 yrs
description: Fourth son of Jacob; received royal blessing that the scepter would not depart from his line.

title: Perez
subtitle: Gen 38 / Ruth 4:18 | Egyptian Sojourn
description: Twin son of Judah and Tamar; ancestor of King David and Jesus.

title: Hezron
subtitle: Ruth 4:18 | Egyptian Sojourn
description: Entered Egypt with Jacob's household.

title: Ram
subtitle: Ruth 4:19 | Egyptian Sojourn
description: Ancestor of David during Israel's growth in Egypt.

title: Amminadab
subtitle: Exodus 6:23 / Ruth 4:19
description: Father-in-law of Aaron (Moses' brother) during the Exodus era.

title: Nahshon
subtitle: Num 1:7 | Tribal Leader of Judah
description: Leader of the tribe of Judah during the wilderness wanderings.

title: Salmon
subtitle: Matt 1:5 | Conquest Era
description: Married Rahab of Jericho after the Conquest of Canaan.

title: Boaz
subtitle: Book of Ruth / Matt 1:5
description: Wealthy Bethlehemite who served as kinsman-redeemer for Ruth.

title: Obed
subtitle: Ruth 4:21–22
description: Son of Boaz and Ruth; grandfather of King David.

title: Jesse
subtitle: 1 Sam 16 / Isa 11:1
description: Bethlehemite farmer and father of eight sons, including King David.

title: King David
subtitle: 2 Sam 5:4 | Lived 70 yrs
description: Second king of Israel; man after God's own heart; established Davidic Dynasty.

title: Solomon
subtitle: 1 Kings 1–11 | Lived ~60 yrs
description: Son of David; built the First Temple; ancestral line of the Messiah.

title: Rehoboam
subtitle: Matt 1:7 | 1 Kings 14
description: Son of Solomon; first king of Judah after the kingdom split.

title: Abijah
subtitle: Matt 1:7
description: Son of Rehoboam in the messianic line.

title: Asa
subtitle: Matt 1:8
description: Godly reformer king of Judah.

title: Jehoshaphat
subtitle: Matt 1:8
description: Son of Asa in the lineage of David.

title: Joram (Jehoram)
subtitle: Matt 1:8
description: Son of Jehoshaphat.

title: Uzziah (Azariah)
subtitle: Matt 1:9
description: King of Judah listed in Matthew's genealogy.

title: Jotham
subtitle: Matt 1:9
description: Son of Uzziah.

title: Ahaz
subtitle: Matt 1:9
description: Son of Jotham, father of Hezekiah.

title: Hezekiah
subtitle: Matt 1:10
description: Righteous king who repaired the Temple and trusted God during Assyrian siege.

title: Manasseh
subtitle: Matt 1:10
description: Son of Hezekiah.

title: Amon
subtitle: Matt 1:10
description: Father of King Josiah.

title: Josiah
subtitle: Matt 1:10–11
description: Godly reformer king fathered the exilic generation.

title: Jeconiah (Jehoiachin)
subtitle: Matt 1:11–12 | Babylonian Exile
description: Carried captive to Babylon during the 597 BC deportation.

title: Shealtiel
subtitle: Matt 1:12 | Exilic Era
description: Son of Jeconiah born during the Babylonian Exile.

title: Zerubbabel
subtitle: Matt 1:12 / Ezra 3
description: Led first wave of exiles back to Jerusalem and rebuilt the Second Temple.

title: Abiud
subtitle: Matt 1:13 | Post-Exilic Era
description: Son of Zerubbabel in Matthew's lineage.

title: Eliakim
subtitle: Matt 1:13
description: Post-exilic ancestor of Joseph.

title: Azor
subtitle: Matt 1:13–14
description: Ancestor in the royal Davidic line.

title: Zadok
subtitle: Matt 1:14
description: Post-exilic patriarch.

title: Achim
subtitle: Matt 1:14
description: Intertestamental ancestor.

title: Eliud
subtitle: Matt 1:14–15
description: Intertestamental patriarch.

title: Eleazar
subtitle: Matt 1:15
description: Great-grandfather of Joseph.

title: Matthan
subtitle: Matt 1:15
description: Grandfather of Joseph.

title: Jacob (Father of Joseph)
subtitle: Matt 1:16
description: Father of Joseph the carpenter.

title: Joseph
subtitle: Matt 1:16 | Husband of Mary
description: Legal earthly father of Jesus Christ; line of King David.

title: Jesus Christ
subtitle: Matt 1:16 / Luke 3:23 | Messiah
description: Son of God, Messiah, and Savior; seed of Abraham and Son of David.
